resources.string: newTalk provides spoken feedback so that you can use your device without looking at the screen. newTalk can be helpful for people who have difficulty seeing the screen.

How to use newTalk
• Swipe right or left to move between items
• Double-tap to activate an item
• Drag 2 fingers to scroll

How to turn off newTalk
1. In Settings, tap Use newTalk. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
2. On the confirmation message, tap Stop. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
